FRIDAY EVENING AT 9:45 PM
Film Screening
Normalville Theater (26-100)

The Normalville Film Bureau has been working on a historical documentary chronicling our city. That documentary has not been finished yet, so please enjoy a screening of "Garden State." Show up at 9:45 pm before the film starts; staying for the duration of the film will be useful.

["Garden State" is an LSC movie; admission is $3 per person.]
